decision: A smoke test of a just-published wheel runs uv with --isolated or with VIRTUAL_ENV unset and requires site-packages in the module's __file__.

evidence.text: uv 0.13.0: plain and python -I imported src/<pkg>/__init__.py; --isolated and env -u VIRTUAL_ENV imported site-packages in uv's cache.

reopen_if: uv run --with stops honouring VIRTUAL_ENV under --no-project.
why: With VIRTUAL_ENV on the dev venv, --no-project --with imported the source tree while the version string matched the new release.

anchors: Exempt the project ITSELF too, not only its own dependencies
decision: List the project's own name in exclude-newer-package too: uv pip install <project> run in the project directory obeys its [tool.uv] cooldown and installs an older self beside the newest dependencies.

evidence.text: Measured 2026-11-19 by the reporting session (contrib queue entry, inherited); uv 0.13.0 here, not re-run.

reopen_if: uv pip install stops reading the project's [tool.uv] from the working directory.
why: A CI notebook job installed a week-old release of the project beside fresh own libraries, exited 0, and could crash on the mismatch.
